name: reboot_emlp2
source: R-REB-5 (results/quadruped/raw/reboot_emlp23_full/config_values.json: models.<name>.structure, models.<name>.config, structure_summary; values captured from ReBoot's built models by gpu-runner, no ReBoot code read). Supersedes the M0 transcription (784-input plain-BP shapes, flagged unfaithful in docs/m0-report.md section 6).
structure: local blocks (linear with no gradient below it, z^2 + z, local head width -> 16; each trained by its own squared-error loss only) then a separate output stack (linear with no gradient below it, z^2 + z, linear -> 16) trained by the main loss. Losses are never summed; every layer has its own Nesterov optimizer at the same lr; backward order: output stack, then the blocks from last to first. Test time uses the output stack. The activation of each block's first layer is the next stage's input.
input_note: 14 x 14 MNIST (ReBoot's preprocessing, gpu-runner's .npy arrays in results/quadruped/data/reboot_emlp1_full: the same 4800-sample subsample as eMLP-1)

blocks.local_loss: squared error, delta = head output - label (no 1/2, no mean), its own NAG per layer

output_width_note: 10 classes padded to 16 outputs with zero targets; accuracy = argmax over the outputs (ReBoot's printed batch accuracy over all 16; the test accuracy is the same over 10 for seed 0)
kind_note: RE/CE is ReBoot's alternating row/column packing of the encrypted model (paper Table 3: RE(64) -> CE(32)). hekit uses one diagonal, batched layout for every layer, so RE vs CE has no counterpart in hekit; the math is the same (ckks_train_nn::block).
init_bound: sqrt(1 / (fan_in + fan_out)) (consistent with the max |W| of ReBoot's seed-0 initial weights); the faithful runs use ReBoot's own initial weights (init_weights_<model>_seed<S>/<layer>.npy, in x out, float32)
lr_conversion: lr on ReBoot's batch-summed gradient; hekit's batch-mean gradient uses lr_sum * B (configs/reboot_emlp1_faithful.json)
lr_schedule: constant 5e-4 for 5 epochs (500 steps), then cosine annealing with warm restarts every 50 steps, stepped once per batch; per-step values in config_values.json lr_per_step (identical for both models and all seeds)
epochs_note: ReBoot's 10 epochs of 100 steps. hekit replays them from one index file holding all 1000 steps in ReBoot's order (train_indices_<model>_seed<S>.txt), so mnist_flags says --epochs 1: one pass over that file is ReBoot's 10 epochs. Do not change it to --epochs 10.

reboot_ckks.source: M0 transcription of the paper (ReBoot's CKKS parameters; unchanged)
